newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Howard says cannot predict Telstra vote.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Howard says cannot predict Telstra vote.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Thursday he was unsure about the outcome of the Telstra Corp privatisation legislation, expected to be voted on in parliament on Thursday.
"I just don't know. I think we just have to wait and see," Howard said when asked whether the passage of a higher education bill in the Senate on Wednesday improved the outlook for the Telstra bill.

The conservative Liberal-National government does not have a majority in parliament's upper house, known as the Senate, which is due to consider the Telstra bill, part of the overall 1996/97 budget package.
It will rely on the support of two independent Senators who say they remain undecided after negotiations with the government over employment conditions for Telstra employees.
The government plans to raise about A$8.0 billion through the sale of one-third of Telstra with A$1.0 billion of the proceeds earmarked for an environment package.
